# amplitudes

## Derivation

* [The global amplitude phase: i-counting and the contravariant vector current](global-phase-i-counting.md) - Vertex i and propagator −i multiply to i for any tree, so |G|=1 and Re G=0 against MadGraph; every vector producer emits the physical contravariant current and carries no sign of its own.
* [Rooting invariance, the diagram anchor and canonical form](rooting-invariance-and-anchor.md) - Graph-property signs live on Diagram; kernel-compensation signs are read at Diagram::anchor (first lowest-arity vertex), so currents are rooting-invariant; canonical form and container equality.

## Design

* [Multi-flow colour in the evaluator](colour-flow-evaluator.md) - Exact Ratio<i64> colour coefficients through colorize, basis and CF matrix; an Op::Flows root and Op::CoeffRat leaves; floats only at fold and bind; the 3/3̄ crossing undone per tensor.
* [Evaluator architecture: compile, bind, evaluate](evaluator-architecture.md) - A process compiles once into a card-independent program, binds a param card at a chosen float type, then evaluates |M|² per point; each tree diagram is rooted into off-shell currents.
* [Four-fermion vertices: pairings, Fermi sign and the cyclic tensor structure](four-fermion-vertices.md) - Per-structure fermion pairing split into feyngraph flow groups, MadGraph's permutation sign already inside our Fermi sign, and the Fierz cut that evaluates cyclic tensor×tensor contacts.
* [Gamma chains, Gamma5 and Levi-Civita nodes in the rooted evaluator](gamma-chains-gamma5-and-epsilon.md) - Adjoint inference along summed spinor indices, Gamma5/Gamma5Amp, EpsilonVout/EpsilonAmp with explicit argument order, P**2 and P(1,2)P(2,1) forms, PMomOut on fermion pairs, the fusion guard.
* [Helicity sum and zero-helicity pruning](helicity-sum-and-pruning.md) - |M|² sums (not averages) helicities and colours, coherent over diagrams; prune_zero_helicities matches MadGraph's NHEL filter bit-for-bit and holds only in the partonic CM with ±z beams.
* [Intertwiner basis, general tier and peephole kernels](intertwiner-basis-and-peephole.md) - The Lorentz evaluator is a general typed node tree; a non-exhaustive peephole layer picks fused kernels by intertwiner-basis coordinates; EFT structures fall through to the general tier.
* [Multivector: the graded 1+4+6+4+1 Clifford representation](multivector-clifford-representation.md) - Multivector<F> stores a Cl(1,3)⊗C element as 16 graded coefficients; Clifford product, Fierz pairing, fierz_coefficients, and the completeness relations that pin them.
* [Per-diagram AMP2 and configurations](per-diagram-amp2.md) - Op::Configs roots and eval_amp2; MadGraph's get_amp2_lines configuration rule, KNOWN_CONFIG_MERGE, and the per-diagram phase oracle; weights applied at read-out.
* [The repr layer: bundle picture, variance, Dirac adjoint and flow](repr-layer-geometry-and-axes.md) - Wavefunctions as sections of Spin(1,3)×gauge bundles, vertices as intertwiners; variance, bra/ket adjoint and in/out flow as three orthogonal, form-induced axes.

## Design Decision

* [Evaluator IR is a flat Op set; variance lives on the register](flat-op-ir.md) - Primitives are irreducible intertwiners named one-to-one with a flat, dataless Op enum and kernel fns; variance and adjoint ride on the waveform slot, not on a node tag.
* [Propagators stay separate from vertices](propagator-separate-from-vertex.md) - The amplitude-closing vertex never propagates, so unfused vertices are needed anyway; separate propagators give N+M routines instead of ALOHA's N×M, at a typed seam.

## Feasibility Study

* [Deriving diagram phases from U(1) charge flow](charge-flow-phase-study.md) - Research-only test of whether charge flow fixes every pinned phase convention: not actionable (n−k=0); the φ/H split is invisible to every oracle; phase = charge flow × i-counting/Lorentz.

## Physics Convention

* [Colour tensors under crossing; epsilon and sextet atoms](colour-crossing-epsilon-and-sextets.md) - Undoing feyngraph's all-incoming crossing transposes each T per tensor and swaps Epsilon↔EpsilonBar, K6↔K6Bar; how epsilon and sextet atoms flow through grammar and basis; what stays refused.
* [Colour lines from the basis, and how flows transform under conjugation](colour-flow-lines-and-conjugation.md) - ICOLUP lines are read from each basis key's T/Tr chains, incoming legs take the conjugate rep, only connectivity is physical; full vs partial (crossing) conjugation of a flow.
* [Convention signs in a diagram's sign and what pins each](convention-sign-inventory.md) - Every relative-sign arm folded into a diagram's fermi_sign (Wick parity, line, tensor line, VVV, contact, gluon-scalar, build, reversed bilinear), where each is read, and which oracle pins it.
* [Fermion flow, bra/ket dispatch and crossed legs](fermion-flow-and-crossing.md) - Flow-typed fermion slots, bra/ket chosen by physical flow, the per-leg crossed bit, and how C Γᵀ C⁻¹ acts on vector, chiral, scalar and tensor bilinears read against their arrow.
* [Fermion-line sign](fermion-line-sign.md) - Diagram::fermion_line_sign: an uncrossed line takes one −1 per internal propagator whatever its vertices; a crossed line takes a single −1; why the fitted alternatives fail.
* [ALOHA Levi-Civita and Sigma conventions](levi-civita-and-sigma-conventions.md) - ALOHA's Epsilon is ε^{0123}=−1; Sigma is half of (i/2)[γ^μ,γ^ν]; a chiral projector beside Sigma keeps its chirality; both pinned against MadGraph via CP-even/odd interference.
* [How MadGraph factorizes colour: colorize, basis, JAMPs, CF matrix](madgraph-colour-factorization.md) - MadGraph splits M into JAMPs times an exact-rational colour matrix from symbolic SU(3) simplification; runtime never sees a colour index.
* [Vector-vertex convention signs](vector-vertex-signs.md) - The colourless VVV source sign, the four-vector contact sign (per vertex) and the gluon–scalar current sign, read at Diagram::anchor; why they are graph invariants; the open W-pair case.
* [External wavefunctions and propagators](wavefunctions-and-propagators.md) - HELAS/ALOHA external vector/scalar wavefunctions and storage; Weyl-basis fermion, Feynman/unitary-gauge vector and scalar propagators with fixed-width denominators.
